# Soft60

> Soft60 is a nervous system regulation app for women created by Shania Khan. It combines a 60-day daily practice with breathwork, meditation, journaling, reflection, daily rituals, AI guidance, and a private community.

## Canonical product pages

- [Soft60](https://soft60.app/): Official Soft60 website and download page.
- [Soft60 on the Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/soft60/id6760143125): Official iPhone app listing.
- [Soft60 on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.frequencyplanner.soft60): Official Android app listing.

## What Soft60 is

Soft60 is a self-guided wellness and personal-development app built around nervous system regulation and a 60-day practice. It is designed for women who want calmer, more intentional days without turning wellness into another rigid challenge.

The Soft60 experience includes morning and evening rituals, guided breathwork and meditation, journaling and reflection, daily video invitations from Shania Khan, Ask Shania AI guidance, the Abundance Bank, the Frequency Vault, and a private community.

Soft60 is not medical care, therapy, diagnosis, or treatment.

## Core concepts

- Nervous system regulation
- Nervous system reset in everyday wellness language
- Reducing everyday urgency
- Daily rituals
- Breathwork
- Meditation
- Journaling and reflection
- Gentle movement
- Eating with presence
- Identity proof
- Subtracting chaos
- Consistency over intensity

## The Soft60 Method

The Soft60 Method is a 60-day framework organized around six daily practices:
1. Regulate daily.
2. Subtract chaos.
3. Gentle movement.
4. Eat with presence.
5. Soft identity proof.
6. Daily reflection.
